---
title: "Web applications"
---

Interactive apps for exploring the course models in the browser. No installation needed.
Each link opens the app in a new tab.

## ARMA Explorer

Choose the coefficients of an ARMA model and see what they imply.

[Open the ARMA Explorer](https://arma-theory-app.onrender.com/){target="_blank"}

## ADL Explorer

Choose the coefficients of an ADL model and see what they imply:
stability, dynamic and cumulative effects, long-run effect, mean and median lags.

[Open the ADL Explorer](https://adl-theory-app.onrender.com/){target="_blank"}

::: {.callout-note}
The apps may take up to a minute to load if nobody has used them recently.
:::
